title: Temporal Skills Market API contract
description: Contract between /algo (serves the API) and /web (consumes it). The root of this schema is the response of GET /predict; the other responses live in $defs. All volatilities are annualized 5-trading-day realized volatility expressed as a decimal (0.24 means 24%): sqrt(252/5 * sum of the 5 squared daily log returns). This file only changes with the agreement of both teams.

Ticker.description: Upper-case stock symbol as used by Yahoo Finance, e.g. AAPL.

Volatility.description: Annualized 5-trading-day realized volatility, as a decimal.

SkillPrediction.description: What one skill (agent) predicted and how much the supervisor trusted it.

name.description: Stable snake_case identifier of the skill, e.g. short_trend.

horizon.description: Time scale the skill specializes in: short = about 1-5 trading days of history, medium = about 5-22, long = more than 22.

weight.description: Weight assigned by the supervisor. The weights of all skills in one prediction sum to 1.

as_of_date.description: Last trading day whose closing price was used (YYYY-MM-DD). The prediction covers the 5 trading days after it.

horizon_days.description: Number of trading days the prediction covers. Fixed to 5 for the MVP.

predicted_vol.description: Final prediction of the supervisor (the market).

baseline_vol.description: Prediction of the HAR-RV baseline for the same ticker, date and horizon.

supervisor_confidence.description: How confident the supervisor is in predicted_vol, from 0 (none) to 1 (full).

model_version.description: Version of the engine that produced the prediction, e.g. 0.1.0.

realized_vol.description: Volatility actually observed over the 5 trading days after as_of_date. null while those 5 days have not all passed yet.

points.description: Past predictions, oldest first, one per as_of_date.

Error.description: Body of a non-200 response (FastAPI's default shape), e.g. 404 for an unknown ticker.
